clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Redridge, Morganth holds the Tower of Ilgalar and commands the Shadowhide gnolls. The banished sorcerer practices dark magic there, far from Stormwind.

Morganth holds the Tower of Ilgalar above eastern Redridge. Cast out of Stormwind's Mage Quarter for forbidden magic, the sorcerer retreated to these rugged heights to pursue the dark arts beyond imperial interference. He rules the local Shadowhide gnoll clan, whose members guard the spire's base. Inside, conjured demonic hounds stalk the tower, and shadowy power threatens Lakeshire below.

The Tower of Ilgalar draws comparisons to the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. Who built Ilgalar remains a mystery, and the towers face one another in quiet magical opposition. In Elwynn, the archmage Theocritus watches Ilgalar through enchanted scrying devices such as the Eye of Azora. He monitors Morganth's experiments and seeks to stop the sorcerer's corruption from spreading through the kingdom.
